newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Rebels seize Zairean town - Burundi army sources.
newsitem.headline: Rebels seize Zairean town - Burundi army sources.

text.p: Tutsi Banyamulenge rebels have seized the Zairean town of Uvira after two days of battles with Zairean troops, state Burundian radio and military sources said on Saturday.
"Uvira...has fallen to the Banyamulenge," Burundian state-run radio said.
"It looks as if Uvira is no longer in the hands of the Zairean army," a Burundian military source told Reuters, adding the lakeside town was seized by rebel forces on Friday night.

Uvira is 24 km (15 miles) west of the Burundian capital Bujumbura across the northern tip of Lake Tanganyika, and 12 km (seven miles) from the border with Burundi. It is an important access route for goods heading north through eastern Zaire.
Witnesses said they saw Zairean soldiers fleeing south in boats on Lake Tanganyika from Uvira on Friday afternoon. The town had been rocked by shelling since Thursday.
